message: #include V_path targets an implementation file; only .h may be included
why: A .hermes file contains bodies. Including one would give every includer its own copy of the implementation and make "which implementation is linked" depend on the include graph instead of on #link — which is exactly the property #include/#link separation exists to protect.
fix: to use only its types, include its interface: #include "V_name.h"
